item.title: PH Embassy in Israel confirms the death of a Filipina caregiver in Tel Aviv
item.description: The Philippine Embassy in Israel confirmed on Sunday, March 1, that a Filipina caregiver died due to the ongoing US-Israeli-Iranian conflict. “The Philippine Embassy in Israel regrets to confirm the death of a Filipino national during a missile attack in Tel Aviv on the evening of 28 February,” the embassy wrote online. item.title: Filipino celebrities try the Hyrox fitness challenge
item.description: More Filipino celebrities and fitness enthusiasts are taking on the global fitness challenge Hyrox, with many countries across Asia emerging as a hotspot for participants. Hyrox is a high-intensity race that combines running with functional exercises, testing both endurance and strength across multiple stations—a mix of sprints, rowing, sled pushes, and more. item.title: Your Monthly Hugot-scope: March 2026
item.description: Narito ang inyong March 2026 Hugot-scope! Ngayong Fire Horse year, mabilis ang galaw ng mundo—parang feelings mong biglang naglaho. Fresh from the Love Month, March is here to remind you na hindi lang spring cleaning ang kailangan, kundi pati clearing of emotions. Heto ang gabay mo para hindi ka "nganga" ngayong buwan. Tandaan: Vibe check lang ito, hindi utos ng tadhana. Nasa kamay mo ang manibela, nasa bituin lang ang hugot.
